beats.title: In the Beginning
beats.short: God made us to rule over His creation, at peace with every living thing.

more.story: When we turned from God, that peace was lost. The wild became something to fear.

verses.text: Rule over… every creature that crawls upon the earth.

beats.title: The Promise
beats.short: Even as sin entered the world, God promised a Savior.

more.story: A son of Eve would crush the serpent’s head. That son is Jesus Christ, born of a woman for us.

verses.text: He will crush your head, and you will strike his heel.
But when the time had fully come, God sent His Son, born of a woman

beats.title: Forty Years
beats.short: God led His people through the wilderness for forty years.

more.story: He fed them every morning, and still they doubted Him. We are not so different.

verses.text: Remember that these forty years the LORD your God led you all the way in the wilderness

beats.title: Forty Days
beats.short: Jesus Christ walks into the same wilderness and goes without food for forty days.

more.story: Where Israel failed, and where we fail, He stood firm. Each time He answered the tempter with the word of God.

verses.text: Man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.

beats.title: Fully Man
beats.short: He felt hunger and weariness as we do.

more.story: God made man a little lower than the angels. The Son of God came down to that place to lift us up.

verses.text: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.
But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than the angels, now crowned with glory and honor

beats.title: The Angels
beats.short: Satan offered Him angels as a test.

more.story: He would not test His Father. When the temptations ended, the angels came to serve Him.

verses.text: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
Then the devil left Him, and angels came and ministered to Him.

beats.title: Lord of the Wild
beats.short: Satan quoted Psalm 91 to Him, and stopped just before the verse about the lion.

more.story: Here the lion and the serpent already lie at His feet. The psalm Satan left unfinished is fulfilled in Him.

verses.text: You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.
I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions

beats.title: That You May Believe
beats.short: Moretto painted the Son of God hungry, and the wild beasts bowing to Him.

more.story: Both are true. He became one of us, so that we could belong to Him forever.

verses.text: These are written so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God
